svg.aria-label: A night skyline of my GitHub activity, JUN 2025 - NOV 2026, above a map of my projects.
svg.title: A night skyline of my GitHub activity, JUN 2025 - NOV 2026, above a map of my projects.
svg.desc: One building per week, as GitHub counts contributions: 52 contributions on 11 days; the busiest week had 18. Taller means more contributions; lit windows are days with activity. Below, one block per public repository: cipherscore (38 files), signalquarry (61 files), notcooked (source private), piano (12 files).
svg.text: 1 WEEK = 1 BUILDING / LIT WINDOW = ACTIVE DAY
